# LIBAS TAILOR

> Official digital presence for LIBAS TAILOR — Master bespoke menswear tailoring and ceremonial Sherwani specialists in Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Business Identity & Verification
- **Business Name**: LIBAS TAILOR
- **Trade / Specialization**: Bespoke Menswear, Traditional & Wedding Sherwanis, Bespoke Suits, Indo-Western Ensembles, Kurta Pajama, Sadri
- **Physical Atelier**: Shamshad Market, opposite Sulaiman Hall, Aligarh Muslim University (AMU), Saheb Bagh, Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh 202001, India
- **Telephone / WhatsApp**: +91 90276 72285
- **Official Website**: https://libastailor.in
- **Verified Profiles**:
  - Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/libastailor_aligarh/
  - Justdial: https://jsdl.in/DT-99VIYPSP4Y5
  - Google Business Profile: https://share.google/RkUWpTVmXFjvQVj9q

## Tailoring Services & Pricing Guidelines
Tailoring labor pricing established by proprietor Mr. Faheem:
- **Kurta**: ₹600
- **Kurta Pajama**: ₹800
- **Kurta Pant Cut**: ₹1,000
- **Pathani Suit**: ₹1,000
- **Kurta Pant**: ₹1,200
- **Pant Shirt**: ₹1,200
- **Shirt**: ₹600
- **Pant**: ₹750
- **Sadri / Waistcoat**: ₹2,000
- **Bespoke Royal Sherwani**: Half Astar ₹3,500 | Full Astar ₹4,000
- **Ceremonial / Wedding Sherwani**: ₹4,500
- **Bespoke 2-Piece Suit (Coat Pant)**: ₹4,800
- **Bespoke 3-Piece Suit (Coat, Pant, Waistcoat)**: ₹5,500

*Terms: 70% advance payment required at the time of order confirmation. Prices cover stitching craftsmanship; fabrics are provided by client or sourced separately upon consultation.*
